title: Sunflower Keys — Turn a rising phrase back through new places
help: A color can return at a new seed. These phrases rise and fall through five colors, fall and rise, or skip the two intervening colors. Drawn preserves their order. Planting stays silent; the same color at a new place is not a longer held note.
rows: Up five colors and down again
Down five colors and up again
message: phrases comparisons preserve the authored experiment without replacing its memory
